frame: local (s, y): s along traffic, y from boarding kerb to footpath, z up from road

not_in_gh.BS_ROOF_LINK: GH layer filter BS_ROOF* picks it up as a normal roof
not_in_gh.BS_SCREEN_PERF: GH filter BS_SCREEN* builds it like a solid screen (no separate material)
not_in_gh.roofH: GH measures from the DXF plane (road, z = 0); the preview adds the 0.15 m footpath

layer_map.BS_ROOF*: g01 roof: offset roof_ov → move to roof_H → extrude roof_t
layer_map.BS_COLUMN: g02 columns: square Center Box / round Cylinder (col_round), size col_s
layer_map.BS_COLUMN_OUTLINE: section seen on site per column (circle = round), drawn at the plan size; GH may read it in place of col_round
layer_map.BS_SCREEN*: g03 screens: bottom gap scr_g, height scr_h
layer_map.BS_INFO: g04 display: posts inf_pr × inf_ph at the line ends, panel inf_b → inf_b + inf_h
layer_map.BS_SEAT: g05 seat plan extruded to seat_sh
layer_map.BS_SEAT_BACK: g05 backrest line moved to seat_sh, extruded back_bh
layer_map.BS_TREE: g06 trunk tree_tr up to tree_ch, crown sphere = circle radius
